description: nMiti lunar calibration corpus - golden fixtures. Live-crawled publisher boundary receipts for the lunar panchang limbs, with per-receipt provenance. Times are NPT (UTC+05:45); resolved UTC = published_npt minus 05:45. Advance crawl of pre-published December pages (both sources had all 31 days online at crawl time); same-day re-verification of Dec 1-14 recommended before the corpus is used for release gating. Rows with prev_gap=true mark that the immediately-previous element boundary in that chain was not displayed by the source (interval spans two limb steps, 38-58 h).

bb.name: BhaktiBharat Kathmandu daily panchangam
bb.conventions: Tithi and nakshatra headline = element running at local noon of the page date (ends AM -> next day, ends PM -> same day). Yoga headline = element running at local midnight of the page date; its Ends field is always same-day. Karana = noon element. Sunrise = local Kathmandu. Starts fields carry a 12:04 AM artifact and are untrusted except where explicitly noted. December note: BB prints Dhanishtha where the canonical name is Dhanishta (Dec 14; publisher-naming-bug flag).

hp.name: Hamro Patro SSR date pages
hp.conventions: Panchang-panel tithi/nakshatra/yoga = udaya (sunrise) element with its end time (may fall next day; samapti weekday disambiguates tithi). Nepali day-words: bihana=AM, diuso/sajh=PM, raat=evening or early-next-morning (00:00-05:59 belongs to the following day). On vriddhi/kshaya-flagged pages (tithi name carries *) the samapti field shows the flagged tithi START, not its end - see flags section. Karana = udaya element. December notes: BS window Mangsir 16 through Poush 17, 2083 (Mangsir 16-29 = Dec 1-14, Poush 1-17 = Dec 15-31); no * flagged pages in this window - the Shukla Pratipada vriddhi (Dec 9-10) is detected from the repeated udaya element, not from publisher marks. Karana knife-edge Dec 27: the Krishna Chaturthi midpoint sits within minutes of sunrise - HP prints Bava while the engine sunrise-instant karana is Balava (documented per-receipt).

ayanamsa_profiles.note: Engine base ayanamsa: 23.87508 + 1.36062*(JD_TT - 2451545)/36525. Fitted per-source deltas (degrees):

karana.note: karana knife-edge: the Krishna Chaturthi midpoint (~06:55 NPT published) falls within minutes of the engine sunrise; HP prints Bava, the engine sunrise-instant karana is Balava - opposite sides of the same boundary, allowed by the calibration knife-edge rule

flags.note: Shukla Pratipada spans both udayas Dec 9-10 (ends Dec 10 08:59 NPT) => vriddhi. HP displays it on both pages without * marks this window (no flagged pages in December); BB shows Pratipada only on Dec 9 (ends 09:02, before the Dec 10 noon). Receipt kept from the Dec 9 page.
BB prints Dhanishtha where the canonical/engine spelling is Dhanishta (same precedent as the Oct corpus naming bugs); the fixture row is normalized to Dhanishta.

Krishna Pratipada (begins Dec 24 ~07:19 NPT, ends before the Dec 25 sunrise 06:51) was never the udaya tithi => the HP tithi chain carries a prev_gap row (Krishna Dwitiya, ends Dec 25 23:50). BB displays Pratipada on the Dec 24 page (ends Dec 25 03:23).

engine_reference_2026_11_07.note: No sandbox engine pre-calibration was run for this corpus: the authoritative engine-vs-receipt scoreboard is the CI calibration + Swiss-truth harness (R7a live since ff8b3ae). Chain-continuity assembly at crawl time verified publisher-side consistency only: 86 BB-HP cross pairs (median delta 8 min, max 17 min), implied limb speeds 10.8-16.3 deg/day, all receipt intervals inside 18-30 h / 38-58 h. First CI run (run 42333826937): all 181 boundary bands, sunrise bands and integrity gates passed; the single failure was the HP Dec 27 karana knife-edge (Bava printed vs engine sunrise-instant Balava, boundary ~3 min from sunrise) - fixed by the bounded knife-edge rule in receipts_calibration_test.dart, not by touching the receipts. December stress cases: lunar perigee ~Dec 22 (min limb duration 19.6 h) and the Shukla Pratipada vriddhi Dec 9-10. NOT part of fixture truth.
